<style>
:root {
  --paper: #f0ece4;         /* website background */

  --muted: #8a8278;         /* muted label text */
  --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
  --panel-2: rgba(232, 227, 218, 0.7);  /* #e8e3da */
  --border: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.18);
  --shadow: rgba(46, 40, 37, 0.12);

  /* restrained VC accents (keep premium, not neon) */
  --blue: #2f81f7;
  --green: #2da44e;
  --purple: #8250df;
  --rose: #7a3b35;          /* website accent */
}

.reveal {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;

}

.reveal .slides {

}

.reveal .slides section {

              linear-gradient(180deg, #f6f2ec 0%, var(--paper) 40%, #efe9e0 100%);

  overflow: hidden !important;
  height: 100% !important;
}

/* All content below the slide title stays inside the frame */
.reveal .slide-body {

}

.reveal .slides section.slide-opener > h2 {

/* Segment map visualization */

.reveal .seg-bubble.b4 { width: 76px; height: 76px; top: 42%; left: 38%; border-color: var(--green); background: rgba(45,164,78,0.14); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,164,78,0.15); }

## The Problem

<div class="slide-body">

<p class="slide-intro">VCs review thousands of startups, but partner time and attention are limited.</p>

<div class="fill-row">
  <div>
    <div class="hero-stat">20,000+</div>
    <div class="hero-stat-label">startups in the pipeline</div>
    <div class="callout" style="margin-top:0.45em;">
      Imagine Shark Tank, but with <span class="metric-sm">20,000</span> startups in a spreadsheet.
    </div>
  </div>
  <ul>
    <li>VCs review thousands of pitches every year</li>
    <li>Partner time is the scarcest resource</li>
    <li>Most deals never get a real look</li>
    <li>Great companies get lost in the noise</li>
  </ul>
</div>

</div>

## Before AI

<div class="slide-body">

<p class="slide-intro">The traditional process is manual, inconsistent, and hard to scale.</p>

<div class="flow">
  <div class="flow-step">CRM Data</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step">Spreadsheets</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step">Manual Research</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step">PitchBook / Harmonic</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step muted-step">Gut Feeling</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step muted-step">Partner Review</div>
</div>

<div class="pain-tags">
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Slow</div>
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Inconsistent</div>
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Hard to Scale</div>
  <div class="pain-tag bad">Data Silos</div>
</div>

<div class="callout callout-accent">
Every analyst does it differently. High-potential startups slip through when there isn't enough time to research them all.
</div>

</div>

## AI-Assisted Deal Flow

<div class="slide-body">

<p class="slide-intro">AI gives deal flow a brain — unified data, faster insight, and prioritized review.</p>

<div class="flow">
  <div class="flow-step">CRM + Harmonic + PitchBook</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight">AI Summaries</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight">Investment Signals</div>
  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>

  <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight-purple">Prioritized Deal Flow</div>
</div>

- External data unified into one view
- AI distills company narratives in seconds
- Signals surface thesis-fit opportunities automatically
- Partners review the <strong class="metric-sm">best</strong> deals first — not just the loudest

<div class="callout callout-purple">
AI doesn't replace judgment — it front-loads intelligence so investors spend time where it matters.
</div>
